blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The hypothetical tandem of Vice President Sara Duterte and Sen. Robin Padilla held the national lead by 12 percent against that of Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo and Sen. Paolo Benigno “Bam” Aquino IV, an OCTA Research survey showed. In its Tugon ng Masa Survey for the second quarter of 2026, 48 percent of Filipinos chose the Sara-Robin tandem as their preferred presidential and vice presidential candidates in the 2028 polls. Meanwhile, 36 percent of Filipinos chose the hypothetical Leni-Bam pairing. “The tandem of VP Sara Duterte–Sen. Robin Padilla leads nationally by 12 points, with 16% still undecided […]...
